children: ICICI Securities's research report on Samvardhana Motherson International

Samvardhana Motherson International’s (SAMIL) operating performance was below our estimate. Nevertheless, the outlook for its global CV volume remains healthy. Furthermore, new platform/model launches from global LV OEMs bode well for SAMIL’s content growth and profitability. SAMIL’s well-diversified business model, strong customer relationships and powertrain-agnostic portfolio position the company favourably, helping it navigate global uncertainties. Non-auto segments (led by consumer electronics and aerospace) are expected to see a strong ramp-up from FY28 onwards, backed by a rising order backlog. Acquisitions remain another key lever to support growth.

We cut our FY27E EPS by ~5% owing to a difference in the timeline of acquisition integration and the SOP of the consumer electronics plant. 3% EPS cut for FY28/29E is primarily to factor in higher interest cost. Maintain BUY; TP revised to INR 205 (vs. INR 210), based on 22x Sep’28E EPS.
